summary: The Mother-in-Law Lounge is a live music venue, pub, and shrine in New Orleans, Louisiana, dedicated to rhythm and blues singer Ernie K-Doe. It sits at the downtown river corner of Claiborne Avenue and Columbus Street in the 7th Ward. The building's exterior is decorated with colorful murals of K-Doe and other prominent New Orleans music figures, especially those who collaborated with him.
one_line: A New Orleans 7th Ward live music venue, pub, and shrine honoring rhythm and blues singer Ernie K-Doe.
